title: Mongo-sharded: Vault-PKI wire mTLS + online cert-rotate across 11 nodes (no re-election) + TLS backup round-trip
description: 0.N.1 (2026-07-10) brings Vault-PKI WIRE mTLS to the 11-VM sharded MongoDB cluster (3 config-server RS @ .74/.75/.76:27019 + shard-1 RS @ .77/.78/.79 + shard-2 RS @ .80/.56/.57:27018 + 2 mongos @ .58/.59:27017), reaching parity with the 0.G.2 non-sharded mongo RS. 0.N was keyFile-only (member auth, NO wire TLS); 0.N.1 makes every mongod/mongos run `net.tls.mode: requireTLS` with a per-host Vault-Agent-rendered leaf from PKI role `mongo-sharded-server` (CN `<host>.mongo.nexus.lab`), while `clusterAuthMode` stays keyFile. Delivered as an 11-VM COLD-REBUILD (destroy -> from-zero apply, ONE pass, 92 resources, zero transients). MongoShardedAdapter gained a REAL `cert-rotate` verb (was a graceful N/A) and its mongosh/mongodump/mongorestore now all dial over TLS. `cert-rotate` re-issues each node's leaf (forcing that node's own vault-agent to re-render) then reloads it ONLINE via `db.adminCommand({rotateCertificates:1})` -- NO mongod restart, NO shard re-election. Live-verified 2026-07-10.

prerequisites.smokeGate: smoke-0.N.ps1 ALL PASSED (incl. new §9 Wire mTLS: per-host leaf CN, requireTLS rejects a non-TLS connection, mTLS ping succeeds); nodes on the current Vault root; every mongod/mongos on `net.tls.mode: requireTLS`

observe.what: GREEN, 16/16 probes -- and every probe now dials over mTLS (config RS, both shard RSes, and the two mongos all speak requireTLS). A healthy sharded topology before the rotation drill.

observe.where: ssh nexusadmin@192.168.70.77 'echo | sudo openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:27018 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject'
observe.what: the shard-1 mongod serves a leaf with CN `mongo-shard-1-1.mongo.nexus.lab` -- the per-host Vault-Agent-rendered cert from PKI role `mongo-sharded-server`, not a shared/self-signed cert

all 11 nodes rotate GREEN with distinct serials and no error -- oldSerial != newSerial per node (e.g. mongo-cfg-1 555E9FA8...->4719E276...); durationSec 78.47, zero errors. A node row with no error means its `db.adminCommand({rotateCertificates:1})` returned ok:1 -- which only succeeds if the freshly-issued leaf/key/CA all load.

observe.where: ssh nexusadmin@192.168.70.74 'sudo journalctl -u mongod --since "2 min ago" | grep -i rotateCertificates'
observe.what: the mongod logs the online cert reload -- no restart line, no stepdown/election. rotateCertificates swaps the running server's cert in place, so no member is ever taken down.
the on-disk leaf serial CHANGED to the reported newSerial and PERSISTS (the per-host vault-agent holds the new leaf) -- a genuine Vault re-issue, not a cache replay

still GREEN 16/16 AFTER the rotation -- config RS still 1 PRIMARY + 2 SECONDARY, both shard RSes unchanged, both mongos serving. NO shard re-election happened: the online rotateCertificates never demoted a primary.

backupId mongo-sharded-backup-20260710-125332, archive /var/backups/nexus-mongo-sharded/mongo-sharded-backup-20260710-125332.archive.gz, sizeBytes 1946, durationSec 0.4. The mongodump ran with `--ssl` THROUGH a mongos (:27017) -- the whole logical dump of nexus_n_smoke crossed the wire encrypted.
the gzip archive exists on the mongos host at the reported size (1946 bytes) -- a real, restorable dump of the sharded `samples` collection

mongorestore ran with `--ssl` through the mongos into a verify DB `nexus_n_restore_verify`: itemsRestored 200, durationSec 1.3. 200 = the full seeded `samples` set -- the TLS backup round-trips end-to-end, restore-over-mTLS included.

whatProves: The sharded MongoDB tier now has genuine Vault-PKI WIRE mTLS (parity with the non-sharded 0.G.2 RS): every mongod/mongos runs `requireTLS` with a per-host leaf (CN `<host>.mongo.nexus.lab`) rendered by its own Vault Agent from PKI role `mongo-sharded-server`, keyFile staying for member auth. `cert-rotate mongo-sharded` is a REAL in-CLI verb (no longer the earlier graceful N/A): it re-issues all 11 leaves durably and reloads each ONLINE via `db.adminCommand({rotateCertificates:1})` -- 78.47 s, zero errors, and NO mongod restart / NO shard re-election, so health stays GREEN 16/16 throughout. Backup take/restore are now `mongodump --ssl` / `mongorestore --ssl` through a mongos -- a 200-item TLS round-trip into nexus_n_restore_verify. Delivered as a clean 11-VM cold-rebuild (92 resources, one pass, zero transients).
